text:
maria: FYI scheduling a controlled network-partition exercise for na-east-1 on Mon 04:30 UTC. Window 30m. Goal: validate cross-region failover, edge routing reconvergence, and SLO tagging for planned degradations. No customer-facing downtime planned but expect brief tailing errors.

jon: Added. Is this a full partition (no egress) or partial (control-plane only)?

maria: Partial: block inter-region pod-to-pod traffic for inference workers while keeping control-plane health checks reachable so we exercise routing and fallback without breaking control-plane writes.

sre-bot: maintenance created: maint-1783012345 | start: 2026-04-06T04:30:00Z | duration: 30m | owner: maria

dave: Load test plan: 0->400 TPS ramp in 5m, hold 20m, decay 5m. Traffic mix tuned to customer-like queries: 60% text-gen, 25% chat streaming, 15% embeddings. Tag run with partition/1783012345.

sam: We'll need to mute some noisy SLO alerts; last time the streaming disconnect alert spammed the channel.

alex: Put the mute scope on `streaming.disconnects` and `inference.high-5xx-count` for the window, but keep escalation on control-plane write failures.

maria: Abort criteria (if any of these persist -> abort and rollback):
- sustained 5m error rate > 3% on inference
- p50/p95 latency delta > 500ms for >5m
- streaming disconnect rate > 2% for >3m

jon: Paste of alert expressions for exact matching (promql):
```
# inference 5xx rate > 3%
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference"}[5m])) > 0.03
# streaming disconnect ratio
sum(rate(stream_disconnects_total{job="inference"}[3m])) / sum(rate(stream_sessions_total{job="inference"}[3m])) > 0.02
```

sam: Prechecks: I'll run `scripts/partition_preflight.sh na-east-1` and post results. It checks route tables, mirror status, and kv-replica counts.

dave: We'll collect full traces + request ids for any 5xx spikes and post them after the run.

product-ops: I'll send customer heads-up banner and update status page to mention "resilience testing" with a contact link.

maria: Operator playbook (short):
1) preflight: `rjctl partition-precheck --zone=na-east-1`
2) enable partition: `rjctl network-block --zone=na-east-1 --scope=worker-egress --dry-run=false --reason="partition-exercise"`
3) monitor dashboards, alerts, and traces
4) if abort -> `rjctl network-unblock --zone=na-east-1` and confirm traffic reroutes

alex: Who's primary during the window?

jon: I'll be primary, alex backup. Sam will own prechecks. Maria owner for coordination.

maria: Small ops policy note: We'll treat this as planned maintenance for SLO accounting. Tag metrics with `maintenance:partition_na1` and add an SLO note in the ops SLO tracker. Post-run we'll run a 2-hour validation sweep to ensure no lingering error-rate regressions.

sre-bot: reminder: maint-1783012345 starts in 48h

dave: One ask: can we limit egress block to the worker-subnet CIDR to avoid hitting shared infra?
maria: Yes, that's the plan. We'll target worker-subnets only.

sam: Preflight green. route-table checks ok, kv replicas healthy, mirror lag < 120s. Posting output to the thread.

dave: All set on loadgen and tags. I'll upload run metadata + raw traces to the thread after the exercise.

alex: Thanks everyone. If preflight flags anything, abort the schedule and rebook. Otherwise proceed. :white_check_mark:
